phase_title: Motion & Interaction — Apple Springs + Cursor Glow
commit_message: phase 6 (aurora): motion tokens + springs + cursor glow + view transitions
behaviors_added: Press feedback — scale(0.96) on click for buttons, dock-btn, tb-btn, gateway-cta, theme-toggle
Cursor glow — radial gradient follows pointer on .u-card-glow (uses --color-tint)
Stagger reveal — IntersectionObserver triggers translateY(8px→0) + opacity(0→1) with 35ms delay between siblings
Auto-tagging — Bento children, cath-stat, cath-dash-card, stat-tile, surface-card all get u-lift + u-card-glow on init and on lazy-mount/state-update
Quick action buttons get u-press auto-applied
navigateTo wrapped with document.startViewTransition (graceful fallback when unsupported)
All new motion respects prefers-reduced-motion (zero animations + no glow)
